# ORQO

> ORQO (orqo.site) is a WhatsApp-first customer platform for small and medium businesses. It brings WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger messages into one shared inbox, gives every customer a single profile, and adds WhatsApp campaigns, automation for repetitive work, and an AI agent that replies to customers and hands conversations over to the team when needed.

The site is bilingual: the default pages under `/` are in Arabic (Egyptian market), and complete English versions live under `/en`. The product itself runs on `app.orqo.site`.

## Pages

- [Home (Arabic)](https://www.orqo.site/): Product overview — shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, AI agent, campaigns, contacts and automation.
- [Home (English)](https://www.orqo.site/en): Same overview in English.
- [AI agent](https://www.orqo.site/en/#journey): How the AI agent answers customers, books, and hands over to the team.
- [WhatsApp campaigns](https://www.orqo.site/en/#campaigns): Campaigns with Meta-approved templates and a report for every campaign.
- [Contacts & CRM](https://www.orqo.site/en/#contacts): Customer profiles, tags and segments that every conversation builds automatically.
- [Automation](https://www.orqo.site/en/#automation): No-code automation flows (out-of-hours replies, assignment, follow-ups).
- [Pricing](https://www.orqo.site/en/pricing): Every feature is available on every plan; plans differ only in usage size. Includes the integrations list.
- [Contact](https://www.orqo.site/en/contact): Talk to the ORQO team — plan questions, demos, channel setup.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.orqo.site/privacy): How ORQO handles personal data.
- [Terms & conditions](https://www.orqo.site/terms): Service terms.

## App (product) links

- [Sign up](https://app.orqo.site/register): Create an ORQO account (free to start).
- [Log in](https://app.orqo.site/login): Existing accounts.
